description: Expected behavior on fixtures/input.json, checked by scripts/test-youtube-niche-breakout-finder.mjs and by QA in the private instance.
assertions: Happy path: 7 breakout videos (ratio >= 2 against the search median, >= 1,000 views), sorted by ratio, with canonical watch URLs; the Short is not scored.
Sheet rows carry exactly the 14 headers of the Breakouts tab and are upserted on Video ID.
Duplicate run: every breakout already in the sheet, so New Breakouts Found? is false and nothing is written to Sheets or Slack.
Empty Actor dataset: readable 'returned no videos' message and no destination writes.
A search with fewer than minVideosPerQuery dated videos is skipped and listed in the Slack digest.
Malformed, empty or unrelated OpenAI output: AI Angles Valid? is false, readable message, no destination writes.
Missing search phrases stop the run before any paid request with a readable error.
Credential-negative: without an Apify credential the run stops at node 2 with a readable error and writes nothing.
Slack digest lists every new video under its angle and the run counts.
